name: atk up
behavior: Battle start: wearer ATK +25% (ATK + ATK/4)

name: atk down
behavior: Attack proc: wearer's own ATK -INT(target)/4 (target unaffected)

name: def up
behavior: Battle start: wearer DEF +25% (DEF + DEF/4)

name: def down
behavior: Attack proc: wearer's own DEF -INT(target)/4 (target unaffected)

name: agi up
behavior: Battle start: wearer AGI +25% (AGI + AGI/4)

name: agi down
behavior: Attack proc: wearer's DEF -INT(target)/4 (bug: AGI never changes)

name: dex up
behavior: Battle start: wearer DEX +25% (DEX + DEX/4)

name: dex down
behavior: Attack proc: wearer's DEF -INT(target)/4 (bug: DEX never changes)

name: int up
behavior: Battle start: wearer INT +25% (INT + INT/4)

name: int down
behavior: Attack proc: wearer's DEF -INT(target)/4 (bug: INT never changes)

name: wis up
behavior: Battle start: wearer WIS +25% (WIS + WIS/4)

name: wis down
behavior: Attack proc: wearer's DEF -INT(target)/4 (bug: WIS never changes)

name: sleep
behavior: On a connecting hit: inflicts Sleep (WIS/2 % cure per action); blocked by Sleep Resistance

name: deep sleep
behavior: Always inflicts Sleep, even on a miss (WIS/2 % cure per action); blocked by Sleep Resistance

name: sleep resistance
behavior: Battle start: immune to Sleep

name: paralysis
behavior: On a connecting hit: inflicts Paralysis (INT/2 % cure per action); blocked by Paralysis Resistance

name: severe paralysis
behavior: Always inflicts Paralysis, even on a miss (INT/2 % cure per action); blocked by Paralysis Resistance

name: paralysis resistance
behavior: Battle start: immune to Paralysis

name: poison
behavior: Always inflicts Poison; the 5 HP/action tick appears unreachable in code (wrong timer cell) — not measured in-game

name: severe poison
behavior: Always inflicts Severe Poison; the 10 HP/action tick appears unreachable in code (wrong timer cell) — not measured in-game

name: poison resistance
behavior: Battle start: immune to Poison and Deadly Poison

name: silence
behavior: On a connecting hit: inflicts Silence (blocks magic abilities; INT/2 % cure per action)

name: severe silence
behavior: Always inflicts Silence, even on a miss (blocks magic; INT/2 % cure per action)

name: silence resistance
behavior: Battle start: immune to Silence

name: auto hp restore 1
behavior: Every 33 action ticks: heal 2 HP (clamped to max)

name: auto hp restore 2
behavior: Every 33 action ticks: heal 5 HP (clamped to max)

name: auto hp restore 3
behavior: Every 33 action ticks: heal 10 HP (clamped to max; highest tier wins)

name: hp absorp 1
behavior: Attack proc: drain ATK-DEF (min 3) from the target, wielder heals 1/3 of it

name: hp absorp 2
behavior: Attack proc: drain ATK-DEF (min 3) from the target, wielder heals 2/3 of it

name: critical 1
behavior: 10% chance on hit: marks the target with the x2 damage flag (not the wielder)

name: critical 2
behavior: 20% chance on hit: marks the target with the x2 damage flag (not the wielder)

name: critical 3
behavior: 30% chance on hit: marks the target with the x2 damage flag (not the wielder)

name: counter 1
behavior: 20% chance to counter a melee hit (attacker within 40px front / 8px back)

name: counter 2
behavior: 40% chance to counter a melee hit (attacker within 40px front / 8px back)

name: counter 3
behavior: 60% chance to counter a melee hit (attacker within 40px front / 8px back)

name: phy reduc 1
behavior: Physical damage taken x0.8 (-20%); highest tier only

name: phy reduc 2
behavior: Physical damage taken x0.6 (-40%); highest tier only

name: phy reduc 3
behavior: Physical damage taken x0.5 (-50%); highest tier only

name: magic reduction
behavior: Magic damage taken x0.75 (-25%)

name: magic reflection
behavior: Magic damage taken x0.75 (-25%); same handler as 38 (no separate reflect code)

name: warrior spirit
behavior: ATK & DEF +30% (x1.3)

name: mage spirit
behavior: INT & WIS +30% (x1.3)

name: hero spirit
behavior: ATK/DEF/AGI/DEX/WIS/INT +30% (x1.3)

name: self destruct
behavior: On death: 59px blast, damage = HP - target DEF (min 1)

name: regenerate
behavior: 10% per action: heal 50% max HP

name: multiply
behavior: 10% per action: clone into an empty slot 4/5

name: revive
behavior: On death: revive once at 50% max HP (consumed)

name: item recovery
behavior: Battle end: a surviving carrier gives each fallen ally a 50% chance to keep its equipped item (kept unequipped; otherwise destroyed)

name: loot recovery up 1
behavior: Battle end: battle gold x1.2 (highest tier only)

name: loot recovery up 2
behavior: Battle end: battle gold x1.5 (highest tier only)

name: loot recovery up 3
behavior: Battle end: battle gold x2.0 (highest tier only)
